title: chore(pm): the skill ratchet counts bytes, and prose is no longer held to a 120-byte line
body:

Fixes #35229

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z) to the fleet skills review and its order of improvements, as quoted in the body of card #35229 (filed 2026-11-18 17:25Z); it carries the byte unit and the end of the 120-byte prose line.

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:舰队内部技能文件的体积上限从按行数改为按字节数,技能正文从此可以写成完整长句,不再被每行一百二十字节折断。
- 属于舰队技能清理的第一步,替所有每次都要通读这些技能文件的席位去掉电报体折行。
- 出错只会让改技能文件的拉取请求误红或误绿,不碰产品与数据,可整笔撤回;本笔改动约三千八百七十行,其中约三千五百行是删掉门禁脚本里旧的逐行账本,新写的只有约四百行。
- 席位契约审核通过后,请你批准或合并这一笔(超三千行且触受管面,只能由你落地)。

## What changes

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` now judges each covered file by one number, its size in UTF-8 bytes (what `wc -c` prints). The 120-byte max-line-length rule, its eight structural exemption classes and the re-wrap machinery (`MAX_LINE_BYTES`, `EXEMPTION_CLASSES`, `wrapLine`, `atomize`, `breakLegal`, `hanAsciiPunctTail`, `splitPrefix`, `classifyLine`, `scanLineLengths`, `lengthVerdict`) are deleted with their header sections and self-test rows. The file name and `check:pm-skill-ratchet` keep their names. The table-row pin (`MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES`, `scanTableRows`, `tableRowVerdict`) stays exactly as ruled, values unchanged.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, the `CEILINGS` map and the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` comment (the re-base and the three dropped declarations).
2. The same file, `run()` and `verdict()` (the unit and the refusal text a seat will see).
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`, exception one (where a readings raise is now booked).

**The map, generated from the merge-base.** `BASE` = `74d3d831d` (the merge-base; it contains PR #35591 at `1bf30f8b`). Re-run and diff it against the map:

```bash
BASE=74d3d831d
git show "$BASE:scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs" \
  | sed -n '/^export const CEILINGS = new Map(\[/,/^\]);/p' \
  | grep -oP "^  \['\K[^']+" \
  | while read -r k; do printf "  ['%s', %d],\n" "$k" "$(git show "$BASE:$k" | wc -c)"; done
```

The map in the script equals that output except three rows, each lowered to the size this PR's own edit landed (lowering is always legitimate); `triage-duties.md` was edited byte-neutral, so its row equals the output. Headroom is 0 on all 60 rows at the head.

| File | Bytes at BASE | Bytes at head | Delta |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 33934 | 33872 | -62 |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 39008 | 38848 | -160 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` | 2682 | 2666 | -16 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` | 12399 | 12399 | 0 |

No row rises, so no raise is taken under the ruled form.

**Cross-file moves.** The mechanism stays, read in bytes (the 2026-09-03 ruling's adopted text is quoted as given). `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` is empty at the re-base, with a comment saying why: the three line-era declarations (into `platform-readings.md`, `landing-operations.md`, `lanes/director.md`) carry `was` values and ruled raises in lines, which no byte ceiling compares with; a zero-byte re-declaration would pin its sources at today's size and read any later ruled raise on a source as the move re-opening. Dropping the `platform-readings.md` declaration also ends the 444-line credit for lines moved into the nine `readings-*.md` files (seat 5's note, item 2). `ruledRaises` stays on the declaration shape for a future move whose destination later takes an ordinary ruled raise.

**Rule lines that stated the old unit, edited in place:**
- `SKILL.md` guard index row: 行数 → 字节数, 实测行数增量 → 实测字节增量; the re-wrap ban and the density clause are deleted (the unit enforces both by construction). 「新增以删减付账」 stays.
- `os-dev.md`: the line on paying the line ratchet keeps only its deletion rule; the density line (whether a re-wrap buys lines) is deleted, void in bytes; the measure-first exception reports 实测字节数.
- `lanes/skills.md` standing promise: 棘轮逐行付账,⛔ re-wrap 筹行 → 棘轮以删减付账.
- `triage-duties.md` exception one (seat 5's note, item 1): a readings increment raises the ceiling to the landed byte size, takes no decision card, and the PR body cites this exception line and the measured delta; it no longer books in `ruledRaises`. The condition line under it is kept as it is: no clause is void in bytes; 不计重排 is now also enforced by the unit (a re-wrap is byte-neutral), which makes it redundant, not false.

**Serial note.** PR #35610 shares `SKILL.md` and `os-dev.md`. The text merges cleanly (`overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`, both directions), but whichever of the two lands second measures those files again and moves their rows.

**Transition for other open PRs.** After this lands, every covered file sits at byte headroom 0. A PR that grows a covered file by even one byte carries a `CEILINGS` row move and its ruling (comment id and measured byte delta in its body), or pays the bytes by deletion.

## Tests

`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: 114 cases pass at `898add71b`. The roster floor moves 164 → 114, with a comment naming what left and what arrived:
- Left (77): the 66 rows of the max-line-length rule and its Han-punctuation break rule; the pin row that read the line rule's table exemption; 10 rows relabelled from lines to bytes.
- Arrived (27): those 10 relabels; a new first half of the pin pair (the byte ceiling meters a wide row too, beside the pin); 16 byte-unit rows: the overage, the unreadable file, twelve unit rows (UTF-8 bytes as `wc -c`; CJK at three bytes; growth at a flat line count is red; a re-wrap is byte-neutral and stays green at its ceiling; a 600-byte ASCII sentence and a 600-byte CJK line green under their ceiling, and the same line one byte over red; the verdict names no line budget), the map denominated in bytes, the refusals speaking of bytes.

Every unit row is a pair or a near-twin, so a line-counting implementation fails it. The battery roster, the floor and the verdict handshake are kept as before.

## Acceptance notes

- The table-row pin is now a second meter beside the byte ceiling, kept by its ruling (2026-08-25, comment 5406811814). Its map, scan and self-test rows are unchanged, except two texts that described the deleted line rule: the refusal's sentence "the one shape the 120-byte line rule cannot reach … costs zero lines" now says the width is pinned per file by its own ruling beside the byte ceiling, and the pin pair's first row (it asserted the line rule's table exemption) now asserts the byte ceiling meters the same row. `advanceState` drops its quotation tracking, which only the line rule read. The pin's printed widths at the head equal those at BASE on all 60 files (diff of the printed lines: empty), including the pre-existing headroom-2 hint on `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`, a file this PR does not edit.
- The three line-era cross-file move declarations are dropped, not re-declared in bytes (see What changes).
- The line-era row comments are not carried forward: they speak another unit and stay in git history at BASE. The review nits PR #35591 left on its row comments end with those comments.
- Part 2 readings: (a) 0 importers, and no file outside the script names the line rule's exports; (b) the rule held only lines outside its structural classes, which are prose paragraphs and list items; no other structured class was held; (c) pin widths identical, above; (d) `check-ratchet-remedy-authority` still reads this gate `excluded` (its self-test green); its `why` text still calls the gate "the per-file line ratchet the 2026-09-03 ruling amends", which is true of the ruling's day, so that file is not edited; (e) every `CEILINGS` and pin key stays a path literal, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` green; (f) the sentence `check-harness-current.mjs` quotes ("`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is read in full by every seat session and every Routine fire") is kept verbatim in the header, now on one line; the hermetic-gate sentence `check-merged-result.mjs` quotes is kept too; (g) `triage-duties.md` exception one was the only other reader of `ruledRaises`; (h) the old script quotes only the skill line itself as the standing exception (「唯一例外:…记 `ruledRaises` 引常设裁决…」, no ruling id or date), so the reworded line points at itself and needs no second home; the checkout is shallow, so the line's first commit was not traced; (i) nothing in `scripts/`, `.github/` or `docs/qa/` parses this gate's printed lines; (j) changed lines: 3867 (+391 / -3476, 5 files), over the 3,000 human-merge threshold.
- Text outside this PR's fence that still speaks of this gate's line unit, left untouched: the header of `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` ("prices `.claude/**` in LINES", fenced by the order), a comment in `scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` ("a shrink-only line ceiling"), and the gate census rows in `docs/audits/` (fenced). No other `.claude/**` line states the line unit or the 120-byte cap for these files.
- Two `.claude/` skill files carry no ceiling row, before and after this PR: `references/instrument-discipline.md` and `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`. The header reads an absence as a fact to check; this PR adds no row.
